subject: fixing all item parameters of single factor model with ordered responses

messages.author: 69c59fb419f3f75e
messages.subject: fixing all item parameters of single factor model with ordered responses
parts:
I am attempting to estimate latent trait variance with all item parameters fixed. Take the code below. I want to use the estimated IRT parameters (which can be converted into loadings and thresholds) and fix them in a lavaan (CFA) model to estimate the mean and variance of the single factor. Is this possible?

# Package
library(mirt)

# Slopes
a <- matrix(rlnorm(20,.2,.3))

diffs <- t(apply(matrix(runif(20*4, .3, 1), 20), 1, cumsum))
diffs <- -(diffs - rowMeans(diffs))
# Thresholds 
d <- diffs + rnorm(20)
# simulated data
dat <- simdata(a, d, 500, itemtype = 'graded')
# fit
mirt_fit1 <- mirt::mirt(dat, 1)
# estimated item parameters that I would like to fix in a single factor CFA with ordered items 
coef(mirt_fit1)

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: fixing all item parameters of single factor model with ordered responses
parts:
yes, if you transform them to factor loadings and threshold, you can extract factor scores

You can also do that with mirt
